name: Removed syntax diagnostics retain migration replacements

applicability.reason: Supported as a DOCUMENTATION audit. C004 requires a diagnostic naming a ledger row to point users at the v1 REPLACEMENT clause rather than treating the historical syntax as accepted source. That is a property of the ledger text, not of any program, so no runtime observation could establish it. The row names the artifact, the pattern identifying a ledger row, and the requirement each such row must also carry, and the validator reports any row citing no v1 clause. Measured: all 37 ledger rows cite one.
